prompt: Use case: transparent game sprite. Generate ONE OPEN rectangular doorway/frame with a fully transparent empty opening and the door slab swung toward the right, in the wall material. Wall construction: hand-moulded warm ochre mud bricks laid in a staggered running bond, small visible straw fibres, soft irregular rectangular edges and thin clay joints. Material: sun-dried clay with straw. Era: Neolithic. Door slab may use rough timber with plain lashings appropriate to the wall, never modern hardware. Straight-on front elevation from the south with only a very small top visible; not isometric, not a perspective room. Entire standing doorway fills most canvas with generous transparent margin and completely transparent background/opening, no ground or cast shadow. Full square outer silhouette, top lintel horizontal and uprights vertical; no arch. Style reference for controlled dark-brown hand ink and warm watercolor earth tones. Keep upper-left edges brighter, right/bottom surfaces distinctly shaded, strong upper-left light. No text or framing. Will be uniformly reduced to 60 pixels tall and padded to 64x60, so broad shapes.
operations: bottom-aligned transparent canvas padding; no pixel edits
seam_applicability: Repeat axes only; isolated end/junction/door do not tile.
projection_applicability: Standing doors only; wall components/top/floor do not have a standing silhouette.
